messages:
Rae (partnerships): Heads-up: kickoff for listing 'Redwood Inference — CloudStore' across AWS/GCP/Azure. Scope: publisher accounts, images/AMIs, SKU + trial flow, KMS + compliance, and listing copy/assets. Calling owners.
Diego (product): I can take SKU and trial UX. Thinking 14-day auto trial + 10k token credit. Any objections?
Priya (legal): 14-day auto trial ok. Need to embed DPA link, regional data residency opt-out, and privacy blurb. I can draft language by Tue EOD.
Asha (cloud-ops): I'll take publisher onboarding + IAM. Need exact AWS account and GCP project IDs and Azure publisher tenant. Please DM. Also will prepare terraform role templates.
Marcus (engineering): I'll own image packaging: AMI bake, GCP image, and Azure VHD. Will set up nightly bake and publish image IDs to SSM/Artifact Registry. Need build role and access.
Rae (partnerships): Great. Target: staging listing by next Friday. Mid-week sync Wed 11am PT.
Diego (product): For pricing tiers: Free trial -> Developer ($49/mo), Team ($249/mo), Enterprise (contact). I'll draft a short pricing table and sample CLI snippet.
Priya (legal): Add clause about telemetry retention (default 30 days), and add option for enterprise to request 90/365 day retention plus SOC2 addendum.
Asha (cloud-ops): Quick terraform snippet for publisher assume role: `resource "aws_iam_role" "pub" { name = "rdw-marketplace", assume_role_policy = <<POLICY {
  \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
  \"Statement\": [{
    \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
    \"Principal\": {\"Service\": \"marketplace.amazonaws.com\"},
    \"Action\": \"sts:AssumeRole\"
  }]
} POLICY }`
Marcus (engineering): I'll wire the bake pipeline to post AMI/GCP image IDs to `infra/marketplace/images` and add a smoke test: start instance, call /health, run sample inference.
marketplace-bot: Tasks created: P-800 (publisher ids) -> Asha, due 1797672000; P-801 (trial UX) -> Diego, due 1797675600; P-802 (EULA + DPA) -> Priya, due 1797700000; P-803 (image bake) -> Marcus, due 1797680000.
Diego (product): Question: trial entitlement via automatic signup vs coupon? I prefer auto to reduce friction; coupons for sales/promos.
Priya (legal): Auto-trial OK with explicit TOS checkbox. For EU customers, we must surface data export options.
Rae (partnerships): Marketing assets needed: hero image, 2 screenshots, 1-liner + 1-paragraph description, and 1 quickstart doc. Can marketing get these by Wed EOD? @Diego please coordinate.
Diego (product): I'll ping marketing now. Also will attach a one-line and 3-sentence blurb here when ready.
Asha (cloud-ops): Note: KMS requirement: we should use a CMK per tenant for private offers. Security has requested key rotation enabled.
Priya (legal): Confirmed: CMK with rotation and audit logs required for enterprise LIC.
Marcus (engineering): Implementation note: images will be minimal, no telemetry baked in by default. Telemetry opt-in via runtime flag.
Rae (partnerships): Plan recap: Asha (publisher + IAM + KMS), Marcus (images + smoke tests), Diego (pricing + assets), Priya (legal docs). Mid-week sync Wed 11am PT. If blockers surface, post here or DM me. :rocket:
